title: Kernel102 checkpoint: full cold reconstruction and exact fixed-word ceiling
body:
Records a fully reconstructed kernel102 checkpoint and a solver-free packing ceiling for its fixed local word. The construction starts from a fresh retimed supplier, applies the pinned #518 pair factory, and verifies 102 independent kernel corrections. Its conditional κ is 0.001393876286575098.

Fresh macOS and Linux Python 3.14 runs pass all 9 root stages, 21 supplier stages and 13 changed local stages, with byte-identical complete results. Both bit and complex suppliers are rebuilt. Validation includes all 800 local columns in both orientations, all 102 missing-correction controls, operation-by-operation physical bounds, the actual 40,320 owner roles, finite invoices, two rational moment engines and 47 strict outer inequalities. The measured global prefix is 205 bits under a 512-bit charge.

The separate exact packing dual bounds this fixed-word allocation family by κ < 0.001394406315999672. It does not bound other local factories, port sets or algorithms. Discovery uses optimization; verification of the published artifacts and dual does not.

#522 and #523 announced higher values while the cold runs were finishing. This PR preserves a reproducible checkpoint and scoped ceiling; it does not claim the current numerical frontier. All-size realization/transfer interfaces remain conditional, and κ=1 is not established. Runs require assertions enabled; the recorded commands use normal Python with `-B`.

Prepared by chafreaky with OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0.
